name: Available Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Available Finance Ltd is in the business of loans and investment[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
Agarwal Finance Ltd (AFL) operates under the flagship of the Agarwal Group. Initially registered as a Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit Taking NBFC and Investment & Loan Company, it now functions as an unregistered Non-Deposit Taking Core Investment Company. 
AFL primarily serves as a holding company with investments in associate and group companies. It extends secured and unsecured loans to individuals and corporate bodies and is also engaged in acquiring, holding, and dealing in various securities including shares, stocks, debentures, and bonds.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.13 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -12.9% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 13.2% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 19.4 days to 96.0 days
